units.source_text: 一个阴郁欲雪的下午，某咖啡馆的一个角落，他嘴里叼着点燃了的雪茄烟，倾听对面留声机放出的音乐。

en.t: On a gloomy afternoon that seemed about to bring snow, in a corner of a certain cafe, he held a lit cigar in his mouth and listened to the music coming from the gramophone opposite him.
The music seeped into the depths of her heart.

units.source_text: 音乐结束后，他就走到留声机跟前，看看唱片上贴的名称：Magic Flute—Mozart（《魔笛》——莫扎特）。

en.t: After the music ended, he walked over to the gramophone and looked at the title pasted on the record: Magic Flute-Mozart (The Magic Flute-Mozart).
